title: Shadow Keep church-basement grace = lethal warp-in
desc: 🟠 KNOWN ISSUE — STILL ACTIVE in 0.2.8 (per release-v0.2/KNOWN-ISSUES.md): with DLC on, the region grace bundle can light the church-basement grace (Church District Lower / Scadutree Base) BEFORE the keep is drained, and fast-travelling there drops you onto lethal moving platforms. Workaround: don't warp to that grace until Shadow Keep is drained. Fix (pending): gate the grace on the drain state. DLC is EXPERIMENTAL; base game is the supported config, so not a base-game blocker. [Reinstated 2026-07-23 — was mistakenly archived as Done; the shipped 0.2.8 still lists it active.]

title: Vanilla-suppress: non-goods check lots leak (client half left)
desc: 🟠 LIVE DEFECT — root cause CONFIRMED (other agent, 2026-07-23), supersedes the earlier shop-weapon-slot hypothesis. Non-goods checks (weapon/armor/talisman/gem-ash) could hand out their VANILLA ware alongside the AP item: the goods lot-blank repoints slots at apPlaceholderGoods (a GOODS row) so it only neutralizes GOODS slots; non-goods wares fell to the id-keyed checkItemFlags suppressor, which only fires if the detour sees the AddItem AND the flag isn’t already collected — so enemy / scarab / scripted overworld drops LEAKED (repros: Ash of War: Lightning Ram 540310, Ornamental Straight Sword 510030). ✅ APWORLD HALF SHIPPED: gen_data now collects the non-goods slots of each check lot into CHECK_LOT_ZERO_MAP / CHECK_LOT_ZERO_ENEMY, emitted via new contract keys checkLotZeroMap / checkLotZeroEnemy — 1013 non-goods checks (978 map + 35 enemy), flagged one-time lots only so zeroing never eats a farmable source; id-keyed suppressor stays armed as backstop for lotless ESD/EMEVD-award checks. ✅ CLIENT HALF LANDED 2026-07-23: check_lots.rs zeroes the non-goods slots from checkLotZeroMap/Enemy (client a98cfc9, CI green); er-archipelago gitlink bumped (0bf4a98). ONLY REMAINING: in-game confirm an emptied flagged lot still fires its acquisition flag so the check registers (repros: Ash of War: Lightning Ram 540310, Ornamental Straight Sword 510030). Ships in 0.2.9.

title: Natural-like progression mode
desc: ⭐ Build-ready (spec + DAG both exist). A mode that gates each region on its legible vanilla key so the player advances through the SPINE in a vanilla-like order — the Threshold Rule: 'enter, then resolve on a capstone boss gated by a real key.' SPEC: docs/history/SPEC-region-capstone-model-20260708.md + WIRING-region-capstone-v0.2.md §1 (dependency DAG, tasks #3–#10). DAG: the lock-chain linearized by features/scaling.py region_sphere (SPINE order == sphere gradient). Primitives are Done (region-spine + legible key-named locks). Task: an option that arranges the capstone locks into the DAG's topological order → natural route; verify with gen-sweep + region-gate tests. Scope: controls progression ORDER only — SCALING stays spheres-based (owned by nr-chain / completion-scaling), not this mode. Full spec now committed: docs/specs/SPEC-vanilla-progression-20260722.md + vanilla-progression-dag.mermaid (the flatten-keep-a-few spine, count/compound gates, DLC fold bloc).

title: Progressive flask grants both axes (intentional)
desc: 📋 TRACKED-INTENTIONAL (not a bug — filed so it stops re-surfacing as one): every Progressive Flask Upgrade grants BOTH a flask charge AND a consumed Sacred Tear (flaskLadder + progressiveGrants) in greenfield/eldenring/features/progressive.py (PROG_FLASK). The original design ALTERNATED rungs (Golden Seeds vs Sacred Tears); switching to both-axes-per-copy was a deliberate change for DLC-ONLY seeds, to catch the player up faster (DLC layers its own Scadutree/Revered economy on top of base flask progression). dlc_only injects 12 copies when no seed/tear checks are kept. Both modes are viable: progressive-on = both-axes (DLC catch-up default); progressive-off = vanilla Golden Seeds + Sacred Tears. Possible future enhancement (low, not blocking): restore the alternating seed/tear schedule as a BASE-GAME option while keeping both-axes for DLC. Already documented in-file; this card is the record of WHY.

title: Restore rune-shop arbitrage (randomize shop costs)
desc: ⭐ Bring back the rune-shop arbitrage — GONE in the current build, Alaric wants it back. A consumable rune (Lord's Rune, ~50k on use) landing in a shop cheaper than its value → buy for ~2k, consume for ~48k (fun). WHY it's gone: gen_data's GOODS_PRICE now derives each rerolled item's price from what it's WORTH (vanilla price → EquipParamGoods.basicPrice → sellValue x10, gen_data.py ~3186-3227), so nothing is ever underpriced. Fix (Alaric) — split pricing by STOCK TYPE: FINITE one-time rows (the shop_rows.tsv AP checks: eventFlag_forStock>0 AND sellQuantity>=1) all get a seed-seeded random cost in [0, 5000] — the fun one-shot flip; INFINITE-stock rows (INFINITE_SHOP_ROWS, sellQuantity -1) stay priced AT COST / at-worth so you can’t infinitely farm the arbitrage. Deterministic from the seed.

CONFIRMED DROP: the Fallingstar Beast at the end of Sellia Crystal Tunnel (m32_08, boss-defeat entry 32080800 in boss_healthbars.py) — a BOSS REWARD, the exact class boss_reward_lots.py already datamines. So [1] fails FMG-name matching (its real GoodsName likely differs from the synthesized 'Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]', or is the un-numbered first-tier name), but its goods FullID IS derivable as boss 32080800's reward lot. Task: pull that reward goods id via BOSS_REWARD_DEFEAT / the reward lot, then either fix the roster string to the real FMG name OR teach presence_floor to inject a roster item by explicit goods FullID (not just by name). Flip the test pin in test_gf_presence_floor (currently asserts UNRESOLVED == ["Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]"]). Verify the injected [1] grants + unlocks its somber tier in-game.
